Name: Faster Horse Variants
Author: GustavoHenriqueRS
Description:
Description
Give your horse style and speed! This mod adds 6 horse models, each with its own look and faster than the default horse. The chosen model is saved per horse — build several stables and keep one of each color.

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Extract the FasterHorseVariants folder into your game's Mods folder (you should have Mods/FasterHorseVariants/manifest.json).
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Main features
- 6 models: White, Black (red eyes), Pink, Rainbow, Fire and Skeleton.
- All faster than the normal horse (speed is configurable).
- Particle effects: a Nyan Cat-style trail on the Rainbow and an animated flame trail on the Fire.
- Buy the Saddles from Marnie's shop for an item + gold.
- Hold a Saddle and click your horse to apply the model (consumes the saddle).
- Fully configurable (speeds, prices, colors) via config.json or Generic Mod Config Menu.

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
- SMAPI 4.0 or newer
- (Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu — to edit options in-game.

Shout outs
- Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and SMAPI.
